title: Seaside 640 "Suite Magnolia II" Forest Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities- Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining- Charcoal grill- 2 adult bikes- 1 dedicated parking spot- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled in the picturesque resort community of Seaside, Suite Magnolia II is a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home that comfortably accommodates up to 5 guests. Proximity to the beach, community pools, and the famous Seaside Town Square for dining and shopping are all part of the friendly experience at Seaside. Guests looking for a serene spot to enjoy the area will love this property’s expansive porches and convenient location!Find relaxed coastal charm at this adorable 2-story home. The first floor boasts 2 beautiful guest bedrooms with private bathrooms—1 with a queen bed and 1 with a full bed and a twin trundle. Outside, let the rhythmic lull of the porch swing chase worries away, or fire up the charcoal grill for a delicious barbecue.On the top floor, high windows fill the communal living spaces with natural light. A soft sofa and armchairs create an intimate and comfortable place to gather for a night of drinks and laughter or watching TV. The eat-in kitchen has plenty of counter space and a table for 6 to savor a meal! Open the multiple glass doors that lead to the balcony and enjoy the salty air or dine alfresco at the 6-person covered outdoor table as the overhead fan provides a cool breeze.Outdoor spaces and a serene interior make Suite Magnolia II the perfect property for a tranquil Seaside vacation. There is parking for 1 vehicle—plus 2 complimentary adult bikes—making it easy to explore the area at a leisurely pace. Book this delightful home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT (Sleeps 5):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full Bed and Twin Trundle, Private Bathroom With Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Living Area: Kitchen, Living Room, Dining Room and Half Bathroom*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Unfortunately, the HOA in this community prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals or for guests to bring their own.*Your rental property may share a courtyard, porch, or lot with another unit that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seaside 640 "Suite Magnolia II" Forest Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 2 Beds 2 Sleeps 5 Full Baths 2 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Short walk to the beach, community pools, and amenities - Steps from the famous Seaside Town Square featuring plenty of shopping and dining - Charcoal grill - 2 adult bikes - 1 dedicated parking spot - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Nestled in the picturesque resort community of Seaside, Suite Magnolia II is a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home that comfortably accommodates up to 5 guests. Proximity to the beach, community pools, and the famous Seaside Town Square for dining and shopping are all part of the friendly experience at Seaside. Guests looking for a serene spot to enjoy the area will love this property’s expansive porches and convenient location! Find relaxed coastal charm at this adorable 2-story home. The first floor boasts 2 beautiful guest bedrooms with private bathrooms—1 with a queen bed and 1 with a full bed and a twin trundle. Outside, let the rhythmic lull of the porch swing chase worries away, or fire up the charcoal grill for a delicious barbecue. On the top floor, high windows fill the communal living spaces with natural light. A soft sofa and armchairs create an intimate and comfortable place to gather for a night of drinks and laughter or watching TV. The eat-in kitchen has plenty of counter space and a table for 6 to savor a meal! Open the multiple glass doors that lead to the balcony and enjoy the salty air or dine alfresco at the 6-person covered outdoor table as the overhead fan provides a cool breeze. Outdoor spaces and a serene interior make Suite Magnolia II the perfect property for a tranquil Seaside vacation. There is parking for 1 vehicle—plus 2 complimentary adult bikes—making it easy to explore the area at a leisurely pace. Book this delightful home today!
